summary.headline: Mercury’s Planetary Applications
summary.text: Mercury’s applications and conjunctions with the other planets are interpreted for native character and pursuits: Saturn brings gravity and subtle learning, Jupiter honesty and prudence, Mars loquacity and deceit, the Sun association with rulers and scholars, Venus love of knowledge and advocacy, and the Moon travel, sound judgment, and love of the sciences.
